definitions.gloss: product lineup, assortment, selection of goods
definitions.explanation: The range and variety of products available at a store or business. Used to evaluate or describe how well-stocked or diverse a shop's offerings are.

examples.english: This store has a good selection.

examples.japanese: {品揃|しなぞろ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧な⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a supermarket with a wide selection near my house.

examples.japanese: ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{品揃|しなぞろ}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧ことで、⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飽|あ}きさせない→飽きる：01815_akiru⟧⟦{工夫|くふう}→工夫：00250_kufuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: By changing the product lineup with each season, they keep customers from getting bored.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{品|しな}→品：03192_shina⟧ (goods) + ⟦{揃|そろ}える→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧ (to arrange, to prepare). Commonly used when talking about shopping and retail. The quality of a store's {品揃|しなぞろ}え is a key factor in consumer reviews.

- {品揃|しなぞろ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ — to have a good selection
- {品揃|しなぞろ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧ — to have a rich assortment
- {品揃|しなぞろ}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{充実|じゅうじつ}→充実：04845_juujitsu⟧⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧ — to enrich the product lineup
